description: Capture a screenshot of a rendered page. Returns the image byte-length and metadata only (the binary PNG is NOT inlined). Example: browserless_screenshot({ url: "https://example.com", fullPage: true, _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

fullPage.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the viewport (default false)

name: browserless_screenshot
title: Browserless Screenshot
